description.value:
You were raised in the Naka Shrine's traditions of fire-style ninjutsu and quick swordwork. Your clan trains you in the early forms of Katon: Goukakyuu no Jutsu before you can read.

You become trained in Intimidation, and you treat the first jutsu with the fire trait you cast each day as if its DC were 1 lower (minimum 1) when targeting a creature unaware of you.
